n3e5bc7105f.headline: Malawi's Inflation Rate Eases to 27.1% in June 2025 but cost of living remains high
n3e5bc7105f.summary: Malawi's inflation rate eased to 27.1% in June 2025. Local reporting says the cost of living remains high despite the slowdown.
n3e5bc7105f.why: Inflation trends shape central bank policy and currency expectations in frontier markets like Malawi, which affect lending costs and investment returns.

n3b364d01fb.headline: Mitsotakis Vows to Recover Funds from OPEKEPE Scandal
n3b364d01fb.summary: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis promised to recover misused funds from the OPEKEPE scandal. He also called for political unity amid instability.
n3b364d01fb.why: OPEKEPE is the Greek agency that administers EU farm subsidies, so misuse of those funds affects public finances and EU payment oversight.

n76705e933a.headline: Analysis finds devolved tax powers could add £4 billion for local services
n76705e933a.summary: A report commissioned by county councils suggests fiscal devolution would boost growth and local government finances. It estimates an extra £4 billion for local services.
n76705e933a.why: Fiscal devolution would shift tax-raising powers from central to local government, affecting public spending and local revenue planning in the UK.

n5c0c88dde8.headline: Iran seizes foreign tanker over smuggling of fuel in Gulf of Oman
n5c0c88dde8.summary: Iran has seized a foreign oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman for allegedly carrying about two million litres of smuggled fuel. The crew have been detained, according to Mizan news agency.
n5c0c88dde8.why: The Gulf of Oman is a key transit route for Gulf oil exports, so seizures of tankers there can add to shipping risk and tension in the region.

n8c23440fe3.headline: Annual house price inflation accelerating but rental price growth cooling – ONS
n8c23440fe3.summary: UK property values rose 3.9% on average in the 12 months to May, up from 3.6% in April, according to ONS figures. Rental price growth is cooling.
n8c23440fe3.why: House price and rent data from the Office for National Statistics feed into inflation measures and Bank of England policy expectations, affecting UK rates and property markets.

n61f74f57cf.headline: Saudi remittances to Azerbaijan see significant uptick
n61f74f57cf.summary: Remittance inflows from Saudi Arabia to Azerbaijan rose 51.5% in the first quarter of 2025. Overall outbound and inbound transfers declined over the same period.
n61f74f57cf.why: Remittances are a source of foreign currency and household income, so shifts in inflows affect consumption and the balance of payments in recipient economies.

n2aadf299a7.headline: AMAZON DRIVERS IN CITY OF INDUSTRY JOIN THE TEAMSTERS
n2aadf299a7.summary: Amazon drivers at the DAX5 delivery station in City of Industry, California, marched on managers to demand a union contract.
n2aadf299a7.why: Amazon is one of the largest employers and logistics operators in the world, so labor relations at its delivery network affect operating costs.

n7ea508acb8.headline: 'TAX-LA’ in India': Netizens flood internet with memes after Tesla Model Y launches at Rs 67 lakh price tag
n7ea508acb8.summary: Tesla has launched Model Y variants in India at prices between Rs 59.89 lakh and Rs 67.89 lakh, drawing social media reaction to the price.
n7ea508acb8.why: Tesla is the world's largest pure electric vehicle maker, and its entry or expansion in new markets shapes its growth prospects.

nfaa1dc9f86.headline: First EU-wide taxes on tobacco to pay for Covid debt
nfaa1dc9f86.summary: The European Commission is attempting to introduce its first bloc-wide taxes on tobacco, e-cigarettes and large companies to repay pandemic-era debt.
nfaa1dc9f86.why: EU-level taxes would create a new revenue stream for the bloc and could raise costs for tobacco makers and large firms operating in Europe.

n3d8fb6491a.headline: Greece Launches Building Energy Efficiency Roadmap
n3d8fb6491a.summary: The Greek Ministry of Environment and Energy unveiled its roadmap for improving building energy efficiency by 2030, in line with EU climate targets.
n3d8fb6491a.why: Building efficiency rules shape demand for construction, renovation and energy services, and they follow EU climate policy that affects member-state budgets.

nb57cdc2517.headline: ICEG urges transparency in GHC 1 energy sector levy implementation
nb57cdc2517.summary: The Institute of Climate and Environmental Governance accused the government of betraying public trust over the GHC 1 per litre Energy Sector Levy and called for transparency in its implementation.
nb57cdc2517.why: Energy sector levies are fuel-price charges that feed into Ghana's public finances and consumer fuel costs.

ne7af33e147.headline: Do you want federal money for an EV or home solar? Time is running out — fast
ne7af33e147.summary: Federal tax credits for rooftop solar, heat pumps and other energy-efficient technologies end at the close of the year, according to Alabama Public Radio. Consumers are advised to act before the deadline.
ne7af33e147.why: Federal clean-energy tax credits lower the cost of EVs, solar installations and heat pumps. Their expiry affects demand for those products and the companies that sell them.

n0dda9baa23.headline: Droneshield surges to fourth consecutive all-time high
n0dda9baa23.summary: DroneShield rose 6.7% to a record $4.97, its fourth consecutive all-time high. The stock has climbed 45% this week.
n0dda9baa23.why: DroneShield is an Australian-listed maker of counter-drone technology, so its share price reflects investor sentiment toward defence-related tech companies.
n0dda9baa23.why_moved: The input reports a 6.7% rise to a record price and a 45% gain over the week, without stating a specific cause.

n9f24408aa7.headline: T&G Global mulls options with main investor eyeing sale
n9f24408aa7.summary: BayWa, the major shareholder in New Zealand fruit group T&G Global, has said in recent days it wants to sell its stake. T&G Global is reviewing its options.
n9f24408aa7.why: T&G Global is a New Zealand fruit marketer and grower, and a sale of a major shareholding can lead to a change of control or new strategic options.

nc3d7c3ecdc.headline: PSX Hits Record High, Then Dips as Investors Cash In
nc3d7c3ecdc.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange touched another record on Tuesday, with the KSE-100 reaching an intraday high of 137,232 points. The index later slipped 562 points by the close as investors booked profits.
nc3d7c3ecdc.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's benchmark index of its largest listed companies, and its moves reflect local investor sentiment and economic conditions.
nc3d7c3ecdc.why_moved: Investors booked profits after the index reached a record intraday high, pulling it lower by the close. Profit-taking after a strong rally is a common reason for a late reversal.

n445b4606ce.headline: First Horizon (NYSE:FHN) Reports Q2 In Line With Expectations
n445b4606ce.summary: First Horizon reported second-quarter results that were in line with expectations, according to FinancialContent.
n445b4606ce.why: First Horizon is a US regional bank holding company, and its quarterly results reflect lending, deposit and credit trends in the banking sector.

n66dc0209fe.headline: Bucharest Stock Exchange closes higher Wednesday's trading session
n66dc0209fe.summary: The Bucharest Stock Exchange closed higher in Wednesday's session. Transactions were worth 81.2 million lei, about 16 million euros, with Banca Transilvania the most liquid stock.
n66dc0209fe.why: The Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB) is Romania's main equity market, and its benchmark indices reflect the performance of major Romanian listed companies.

n58351c4922.headline: Senate votes to move ahead with Trump’s request for $9 billion in spending cuts
n58351c4922.summary: The Senate voted to move ahead with President Trump's request for $9 billion in spending cuts. Some lawmakers warned of effects on global poverty programs and local public broadcasters.
n58351c4922.why: Federal spending decisions shape fiscal deficits, Treasury issuance and the outlook for government-funded sectors. Congressional votes on rescissions are closely watched by bond and equity investors.

nb58b703249.headline: ABAX Expands in Real Estate & Tackles Metro Line 4 Project
nb58b703249.summary: ABAX is accelerating its real estate growth with luxury properties and infrastructure investments. The company has a key role in the development of Athens Metro Line 4.
nb58b703249.why: ABAX is a Greek construction and real estate group. Large infrastructure projects like Athens Metro Line 4 can drive long-term contract revenue for listed contractors.

nfcc0f25f1e.headline: ITC Hotels' profit falls 48 pc sequentially, revenue slips over 23 pc
nfcc0f25f1e.summary: ITC Hotels reported a 48% quarter-on-quarter drop in net profit to Rs 133 crore in Q1, from Rs 257 crore in Q4, with revenue slipping over 23%.
nfcc0f25f1e.why: ITC Hotels is the hospitality arm of the Indian conglomerate ITC, and its quarterly results indicate demand and pricing trends in Indian hotels.

nfcd82ebdeb.headline: MTG unveils bill to ax ‘unfair’ tax on homeowners, says it’s a ‘gift’ for the people — here’s Trump’s response
nfcd82ebdeb.summary: Marjorie Taylor Greene has unveiled a bill to eliminate what she calls an unfair tax on homeowners, arguing it could help boost the nation's housing supply.
nfcd82ebdeb.why: Changes to homeowner taxation affect housing costs and supply, which matter for real estate and mortgage markets.

nfdec4712d8.headline: New Zealand reevaluates housing policy amid climate change
nfdec4712d8.summary: New Zealand's government has traditionally bought real estate damaged by natural disasters. It has spent billions of dollars on rising recovery and relocation costs as extreme weather intensifies.
nfdec4712d8.why: Government spending on disaster recovery and property buyouts affects public finances, insurance markets and property values in exposed regions.

n2f8f9a43b7.headline: France Supports EU's Trade Weapon Against US Amid Tariff Tensions
n2f8f9a43b7.summary: France is pushing for the EU's Anti-Coercion Instrument to be used against the US as tensions rise over potential tariffs and stalled negotiations.
n2f8f9a43b7.why: The Anti-Coercion Instrument lets the European Union respond with trade measures against economic pressure, so its use would affect transatlantic trade.

n06511858f9.headline: EU’s ‘green’ fuel mandate costly and not helping environment, IATA says
n06511858f9.summary: The International Air Transport Association says the EU's green fuel mandate is costly and not helping the environment. It noted that SAF production is expected to reach 2 million metric tons.
n06511858f9.why: The EU mandate requires airlines to blend sustainable aviation fuel into jet fuel, adding cost to air travel. IATA is the global trade body representing airlines.

n2f0699bf52.headline: Changes to CAP - Midwest Radio
n2f0699bf52.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced a new Common Agricultural Policy within a proposed €2 trillion seven-year EU budget. The plan followed farmer protests outside the parliament in Brussels.
n2f0699bf52.why: The Common Agricultural Policy is the EU's largest budget item and shapes subsidies for farmers and food producers across member states.

source.name: Midwest Radio - Midwest Radio Local Radio Station For The West Of Ireland (MWR)

sources.name: Midwest Radio - Midwest Radio Local Radio Station For The West Of Ireland (MWR)

n5979ab2bae.headline: France considers axing two bank holidays - could it happen in the UK?
n5979ab2bae.summary: France is considering axing two bank holidays, with one possibly moved to the autumn. The idea is under discussion as a possible change to the public calendar.
n5979ab2bae.why: Public holiday changes affect working days and output in France, one of the eurozone's largest economies, and are part of wider fiscal debates.

n1a824a7e91.headline: ALIMENTATION COUCHE-TARD ANNOUNCES WITHDRAWAL OF PROPOSAL TO ACQUIRE SEVEN & I HOLDINGS DUE TO LACK OF ENGAGEMENT
n1a824a7e91.summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard announced it has withdrawn its proposal to acquire Seven & i Holdings due to a lack of engagement. The announcement was made via PR Newswire.
n1a824a7e91.why: Couche-Tard is a Canadian convenience store operator, and Seven & i Holdings owns the 7-Eleven chain in Japan. Large cross-border takeover attempts affect both companies' strategic and financial outlook.

impacts.name: Alimentation Couche-Tard
impacts.why: The company withdrew its proposal to acquire Seven & i Holdings, ending the takeover attempt.

n0ce0ef3fbb.headline: Japan's Kawasaki Kisen Prepared to Reroute More Ships Away From US Over Tariffs, CEO Says
n0ce0ef3fbb.summary: Kawasaki Kisen is adjusting its US services and is prepared to reroute more ships to other regions. CEO Takenori Igarashi said the company is bracing for potentially higher US tariffs.
n0ce0ef3fbb.why: Kawasaki Kisen, known as K-Line, is a major Japanese shipping company, and freight routing changes affect shipping costs and port volumes. Tariff-driven rerouting can alter global container trade patterns.

nfd312f143c.headline: US stocks swing as President Trump says he ‘talked about the concept’ of firing the Federal Reserve’s chair
nfd312f143c.summary: US stocks were shaky on Wednesday after President Donald Trump said he had talked about the concept of firing the head of the Federal Reserve.
nfd312f143c.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, so questions about its leadership and independence affect bond yields, the dollar and equity valuations. The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies.
nfd312f143c.why_moved: Stocks swung after the president said he had talked about the concept of firing the Fed chair, which raises concern over central bank independence.

nbf6a126345.headline: Unionized Canada Post workers to vote on deal starting July 21
nbf6a126345.summary: Unionized Canada Post workers will vote directly on the employer's offers for a new collective agreement. The Canada Industrial Relations Board will run the vote between July 21 and August 1.
nbf6a126345.why: Canada Post is the country's national postal service, and labour settlements affect its costs, service levels and the delivery of parcels and mail.

nbe04ee557f.headline: Saturn Oil & Gas Inc. Announces Results of Substantial Issuer Bid
nbe04ee557f.summary: Saturn Oil & Gas announced the results of its substantial issuer bid, the company said in a July 16, 2025 release. The light oil producer operates assets in Saskatchewan.
nbe04ee557f.why: A substantial issuer bid is a share buyback that reduces shares outstanding, and Saturn is a light oil producer in western Canada.

nade8ed7d8a.headline: Canada tightens steel import rules, prioritizes Canadian-made steel for domestic projects
nade8ed7d8a.summary: Canada is tightening steel import rules and giving priority to Canadian-made steel for domestic projects, with the government citing the need for much more steel for projects of national interest.
nade8ed7d8a.why: Steel is a core input for construction, energy and manufacturing, so import rules shape costs and sourcing for domestic producers and foreign exporters alike.
